extracted.name: Spinach Pasta Salad
extracted.description: This summery spinach pasta salad is loaded with farfalle pasta, baby spinach, feta, red onion, and olives tossed in a bright and tangy lemon dressing.
ingredient_lines: 10 ounces baby spinach, rinsed and torn into bite-size piece
2 ounces crumbled feta cheese with basil and tomato
1 (15 ounce) can black olives, drained and chopped
instruction_lines: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook pasta until al dente, rinse under cold water and drain.
Combine cooked pasta, spinach, feta cheese, red onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk salad dressing, garlic, lemon juice, garlic salt, and pepper together until well combined; pour over spinach salad and toss to coat.
